injuries.name: Pavel Mintyukov
injuries.note: Mintyukov last played Tuesday against the Islanders, so this move might be retroactive to that date. Travis Mitchell was summoned from AHL San Diego in a corresponding move. Mintyukov had two assists, two PIM, five shots, one hit and 16 blocks in nine appearances before sustaining the injury. Nick Jensen might play regularly during Mintyukov's absence.

injuries.name: Ian Moore
injuries.note: Moore has been on injured reserve since the start of the regular season due to a lower-body injury he sustained on the first day of training camp. While he was given a return timetable of 2-4 weeks in mid-September, he's slated to miss more time than that, and he seems to have several steps to clear before he's in the mix to return to game action.

injuries.name: Ryan Poehling
injuries.note: Poehling was placed on injured reserve Tuesday morning, and the specifics of his injury have revealed that he's set to likely be sidelined into late November. In his absence, Roger McQueen, the 10th overall pick from the 2025 NHL Entry Draft, is expected to play in the team's middle six up the center of the ice. The 27-year-old Poehling was off to a solid start to the 2026-27 campaign prior to going down, posting a pair of points and solid category-coverage numbers across five games.

injuries.name: Troy Terry
injuries.note: Terry isn't expected to be back until mid-November at the earliest, so this transfer doesn't impact his timetable. He had 19 goals and 57 points in 61 regular-season appearances in 2025-26. Terry should occupy a top-six role and play on the first power-play unit once he's healthy.

injuries.name: Ryan Poehling
injuries.note: Lower-Body: The Ducks said on Tuesday (Oct. 13) that Poehling is expected to miss 6-8 weeks with an MCL sprain.

injuries.name: Troy Terry
injuries.note: Hip: The Anaheim Ducks placed F Troy Terry on long-term injured reserve on Wednesday (Sept. 30).

injuries.name: Justin Danforth
injuries.note: Danforth's move to IR allowed the Sabres to activate Sam Carrick (middle body) ahead of Thursday's game versus the Ducks. Danforth remains without a clear timeline to return to action. He will miss his fourth straight game Thursday and will be eligible to return whenever ready, as long as he doesn't later end up on long-term injured reserve.

injuries.name: Jiri Kulich
injuries.note: Kulich missed Saturday's 4-3 overtime loss to Washington and won't join his teammates for the California portion of Buffalo's road trip. The Sabres visit San Jose on Tuesday, Anaheim on Thursday and Los Angeles on Saturday. It's unclear when Kulich will be available to return to the lineup. He has one goal, two assists, nine shots on net, three blocked shots and seven hits in eight appearances this season.

injuries.name: Alex Lyon
injuries.note: According to the team, Lyon was originally expected to be in the crease for Tuesday's road clash with Montreal before suffering his setback. Even once given the all-clear, there may not be enough games to go around to make Lyon more than a low-end fantasy target, especially as long as Buffalo continues rostering three goalies.

injuries.name: Matt Grzelcyk
injuries.note: Buffalo placed Grzelcyk on injured reserve Tuesday. He hasn't played since Opening Night against Columbus on Oct. 1. With Rasmus Dahlin (upper body) and Grzelcyk unavailable, the Sabres recalled Dennis Gilbert from AHL Rochester to play against Montreal on Tuesday.

injuries.name: Conor Timmins
injuries.note: After getting hurt in Saturday's preseason finale against Pittsburgh, Timmins is on injured reserve for the beginning of the 2026-27 campaign. He registered eight assists, 44 shots on goal, 81 blocked shots and 29 hits in 39 regular-season appearances with Buffalo in 2025-26.

injuries.note: After initial reports regarding Capobianco's injury expected him to miss at least one week, he's likely going to miss four times that following his recent MRI. It's a tough loss for the Stars and Capobianco, who had posted three shots on net, four PIM, two hits and three blocked shots across five appearances this season. In his absence, Trey Taylor is expected to make his NHL debut Thursday and likely play until Esa Lindell (lower body) is activated from injured reserve. Barring any setbacks, Capobianco should have a chance to rejoin the Stars' lineup prior to the start of December.

injuries.name: Esa Lindell
injuries.note: Lindell has missed each of the Stars' last three games with a lower-body injury, but is seemingly nearing a return. When healthy, the 32-year-old blueliner has been solid this season, compiling a plus-4 rating, four shots on net, five hits and 18 blocked shots across nine games. The left-shot winger will likely continue his development with the Barracuda once he moves past his injury.
